description: Lists the latest videos of one YouTube channel, newest first, with title, URL, views, duration and publish time. Use it to monitor a channel's uploads or to pick its videos for transcripts or comments. Use job_youtube_search instead to find videos by topic across all channels. Use job_youtube_transcript instead for what is said inside one video. Cost: $0.0002 per video row plus $0.0015 per run, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

max_results.description: Most video rows to return and pay for (default 30, at most 500); the run stops there.

name: job_youtube_channel

items.description: {rank, videoId, url, title, viewCount, duration, durationSeconds, publishedTimeText, channelName, channelHandle, subscriberCount}

usable.description: rows that carry data (only these are charged)

title: A YouTube channel's latest videos
